text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Is this about right for next year's 
expedition plan? All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo. Busy as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Big Sis...? Are you back?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Journey, let's go on a Christmas journey. 
Ah, and do wear your absolute finest 
outfit!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Big Sis. ...Is 
this what you wanted?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it suits you well. Now then... shall 
we begin? Starting now, we're the "Santas" 
delivering happiness.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Funnyaka~... hannyaka~...! We shall not 
suffer~! Merry Christmas~...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Journey, there are souvenirs from my 
travels in this bag. Please pick out a 
present for Fukukitaru from among them.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Then, I'll go with this.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru! Here's a Christmas present for 
you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! A bobblehead of a foreign 
gentleman...?! Its head actually moves~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, gold paper came out of its mouth! Is 
it a fortune!? I can't read the words, but 
I'm sure it's 'Great Blessing'!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Haha, exactly. I feel super lucky."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My good luck power is shooting through the 
roof! There's no doubt this is gonna be a 
wonderful Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Nice, Journey. Let's keep this momentum 
going!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Here's a... fishing rod for you, Sky-san.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“......Ahaha, what a weird shape. Does it 
have some kind of history behind it?”

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a legendary fishing rod that 
supposedly reeled in a crazy monster fish 
in some country a long, long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the "Lord of the River", huh? Well 
then, wanna go see if the legend is true~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~... It's an outfit for a doll~! 
Crimson velvet fabric with gold lace 
embroidery... It's just perfect for a 
Christmas party, isn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, maybe I could invite the two of you to 
the party~?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Journey, you're running, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes... I would love to participate.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Be sure to invite McQueen along 
too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course~ Ehehe~ I'm so looking 
forward to it~♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(A heartfelt welcome. A warm smile... Big 
Sis's whim has—...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Man, we really went all over the place. 
How was it, Journey? Today's trip, I 
mean."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It was overflowing with so much 
brilliance. Truly... a reflection of your 
own journey.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Brilliance, huh. Then Fukukitaru is that 
star. Sky is... that one a bit further 
away. And Bright is that slowly twinkling 
star over there!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If you connect all of them... look, you 
get a delightful constellation!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A game of connecting stars, is it...? To 
put it your way, was a new constellation 
just born?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. An endless amount will be born. 
Whatever kind of picture you paint, it's 
up to the traveler to decide.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Journey, even a detour can be nice every 
once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you try tracing it too? The 
trajectory of infinity.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's true. Is that why it makes 
one want to chase after it...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As if casting a spell... With free and 
capricious, golden fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
âLook, if luck is on your side, you 
might just encounter such a sweet flavor.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Cookies... are they? To think you prepared 
some for me as well... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A parting gift. I had fun today.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Have a wonderful journey, good child. May 
you have a dreamlike, marvelous trip!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The journey you speak of is breathtakingly 
beautiful. —I wish you a wonderful journey 
as well, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I entered the committee room, 
I was greeted by the gentle, rich aroma of 
coffee brewed by Dream Journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Here you go, Trainer. Be careful, it's 
hot."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I had a dream last night. A very, very 
wonderful dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over at the plan sheet on the 
desk, I see that a few of the scheduled 
items have been quietly crossed out.
choice_data_list: …Huh? Did you cut back on the schedule?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
An unplanned detour... I suppose having a 
day like this once in a while isn't so 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It's merely a whim, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cookies served alongside the coffee 
carried a mysterious aroma, reminiscent of 
a faraway land.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu... In your dreams.
